title: UNDERBRIDGE VEHICLE RENTAL & RIGGING SERVICES FOR BRIDGE INSPECTIONS AT VARIOUS LOCATIONS IN CA Date: 2026
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE ARMY.US ARMY CORPS OF ENGINEERS.ENGINEER DIVISION NORTH ATLANTIC.ENDIST PHILADELPHIA.W2SD ENDIST PHILADELPHIA
description_text: Contractor shall furnish an Aspen Truck Model UB32 or equivalent (a submittal of specifications for an equivalent truck, if the truck is other than the one specified, MUST be submitted with the Price Schedule at time of offer) with basket and a qualified operator to facilitate the inspection of the following bridges located in California. Mobilization, demobilization, travel, and all other expenses related to this service are to be included in the cost of this procurement. Duration and dates: The inspection is scheduled for the dates listed in the table below, but may be subject to change. Ten hour workdays are to be assumed
